=# CHEMISTRY QUESTION GENERATION ## INPUTS (USE EXACTLY) - Board: `{{ $json.Board }}` - Subject: `{{ $json.Subject }}` - Class: `{{ $json.Class }}` - Chapter No: `{{ $json['Chapter Number'] }}` - Chapter Name: `{{ $json['Chapter Name'] }}` - Concept No: `{{ $json['Concept Number'] }}` - Concept Name: `{{ $json['Concept Name'] }}` - Level: `{{ $json.questionLevel }}` - Type: `{{ $json.QuestionType }}` ## COMPLEXITY-AND-TYPE PROMPT (FOLLOW STRICTLY) {{ $json.questionPrompt }} --- ## OUTPUT FORMAT (NON-NEGOTIABLE) Every question MUST begin with this exact standalone paragraph and nothing else on that line: ```html

QUESTION_START

``` For MCQ / SCQ / A&R / T-F-style items, follow with: ```html

Question text here

  • A] Option A
  • B] Option B
  • C] Option C
  • D] Option D

Answer : B,D

``` For VSA / SA / LA, follow with: ```html

Question text here

Answer : Model answer text here

``` For CASE_STUDY, follow with: ```html

Passage: ...

  1. (i) Sub-question text ... Answer : C
  2. (ii) Sub-question text ... Answer : A
  3. (iii) Sub-question text ... Answer : ...
  4. (iv) Sub-question text ... Answer : ...
``` ## HTML RULES (STRICT) - Allowed tags only: `

`, `

    `, `
      `, `
    1. `. - No ``, ``, ``, `

      -

      `, no Markdown anywhere. ## KATEX RULES (STRICT) - Wrap every math/chem expression inline with single `$...$`. - Never use `\[ \]` or `\( \)`. - No spaces between `$` and the expression. - Single-line expressions only. - Examples: `$H_2O$`, `$K_c$`, `$\Delta H$`, `$E_{cell} = E^{\circ}_{cell} - \frac{0.0591}{n}\log Q$`. ## RESTRICTIONS - No hallucinations — only use the reference PDF and inputs above. - No introductions, summaries, or closing text. - No metadata in the output. - Output ONLY the questions in the format above.
